name: Kaidan Restaurant - Zoku! Shin Menu 100-sen
original_name: 怪談レストラン ゾク! 新メニュー100選
source:
It contains a brand new set of 100 original ghost stories. This time, the scares are cranked up with even creepier sound effects, super-realistic graphics, and intense visuals! Plus, there might be some hidden spooky tricks scattered all over... so watch out!
It’s not just stories—you’ll get scary (and handy) tools to play with your friends, plus creepy minigames. When you start up, you’ll be greeted by the ghostly waiter you know from the books and anime—he’s got plenty to say in his signature voice!
The new “Ghost Hunter” mode lets you collect spirits! Blow away ghostly shadows that appear while reading scary stories. When you finish a story, tap at just the right moment to catch a ghost! The more ghosts you collect, the more you can customize your Fear Level for each story.
Read lots of stories and get friendly with the ghost waiter to earn “Ghost Story Coins.” Use those coins in the gacha to score plate fragments! Collect enough pieces to restore a plate and unlock even scarier minigames.

[Translated from [url=https://www.nintendo.co.jp/ds/software/tk2j/index.html]nintendo.co.jp[/url]]
translation:
它包含一套全新的100个原创鬼故事。这一次，恐怖的声音效果、超逼真的图形和强烈的视觉效果更加令人恐惧！另外，可能还有一些隐藏的诡异诡计散布各处……所以要小心！
这不仅仅是故事，你还将获得与朋友一起玩的可怕（且方便）的工具，以及令人毛骨悚然的小游戏。当你开始时，你会受到书本和动漫中熟悉的幽灵服务员的欢迎——他用他标志性的声音有很多话要说！
全新“幽灵猎人”模式让你收集灵魂！吹走阅读恐怖故事时出现的幽灵阴影。当你完成一个故事时，在适当的时刻点击即可抓住鬼魂！你收集的鬼魂越多，你就越能为每个故事定制你的恐惧等级。
阅读大量故事并与幽灵服务员友好相处，即可赚取“幽灵故事币”。使用扭蛋中的硬币来获得盘子碎片！收集足够的碎片来恢复盘子并解锁更可怕的迷你游戏。

[译自[url=https://www.nintendo.co.jp/ds/software/tk2j/index.html]nintendo.co.jp[/url]]
